info.title: xCloud Agent Skills — API Reference
info.description:
The **xCloud agent skills** let any AI agent (Claude Code, OpenCode, and others)
operate xCloud in plain language — *"reboot my Hermes server"*, *"renew SSL for
example.com"*, *"scan example.com for vulnerabilities"*. Under the hood every
skill calls this **xCloud Public API**.

This reference documents the API surface those skills cover, grouped by skill.
You normally never call it by hand — you talk to the agent. It's here so you can
see exactly what each skill can do, what scope it needs, and what each request
takes.

> **Skills repo:** <https://github.com/xCloudDev/xcloud-agent-skills>
> **User guide:** <https://github.com/xCloudDev/xcloud-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md>
> **Install & call reference:** <https://github.com/xCloudDev/xcloud-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/SKILLS-GUIDE.md>

## Install in Claude Code

1. **Install the plugin:**

   ```
   /plugin marketplace add xCloudDev/xcloud-agent-skills
   /plugin install xcloud
   /reload-plugins
   ```

2. **Add your API token.** Get one from the xCloud dashboard → **Profile → API
   Tokens → Generate New Token** (copy it once). Then add to
   `~/.claude/settings.json`:

   ```json
   { "env": { "XCLOUD_API_TOKEN": "your-token-here" } }
   ```

   Restart Claude Code so it picks up the token.

3. **Check it works.** Ask Claude: *"Check my xCloud API connection."* Green
   light = you're ready.

That's it — everything below is just talking to Claude.

## The five skills

| Skill | Owns |
|---|---|
| `xcloud:servers` | Servers, PHP, databases, cron, firewall/fail2ban, sudo users, WordPress provisioning |
| `xcloud:sites` | Site lifecycle: status, backups, domains, cache, SSH, site cron, git |
| `xcloud:wordpress` | WP plugins/themes/updates, WP_DEBUG, magic login, vulnerabilities, PageSpeed |
| `xcloud:ssl` | SSL certificates: view, install, renew, status, delete |
| `xcloud:account` | Current user, API tokens, Cloudflare integrations, blueprints, health |

## Example requests

You don't name skills or endpoints — you describe what you want in plain
language and Claude picks the right skill and chains the steps.

**One-liners:**

- *"List my xCloud servers."*
- *"Is example.com up right now?"*
- *"Renew the SSL certificate for shop.example.com."*
- *"Update all plugins on example.com, but back up first."*
- *"Scan example.com for vulnerabilities and show me the critical ones."*
- *"Something's hammering my server from 203.0.113.7 — block it."*

**Multi-step workflows** (each is a single request — Claude does the chaining):

- **Monday-morning health audit** — *"Audit example.com — is it up, is SSL
  healthy, any vulnerabilities, and how's performance?"*
  Checks the site is serving, inspects SSL expiry, runs a vulnerability scan, and
  runs a PageSpeed scan, then returns one summary.

- **Safe WordPress update** — *"WooCommerce has an update — apply it to
  example.com, but back up first and tell me if anything looks off."*
  Takes a labelled backup and waits for it, applies the update, then confirms the
  site is still healthy. Follow up with *"restore the backup you just took"* to
  roll back.

- **New site go-live** — *"I just provisioned shop.example.com — set up HTTPS and
  confirm it's serving."*
  Installs a Let's Encrypt certificate, waits for issuance, verifies HTTPS, and
  runs a baseline PageSpeed scan.

- **Triage a site that's down** — *"example.com is throwing 502 errors — what's
  going on?"*
  Pulls site status, recent events, and SSH/user config to spot the usual
  culprits (stopped service, missing OS user, failed deploy).

> If Claude ever reaches for the wrong area, name it:
> *"Using xcloud:ssl, renew the cert for example.com."*

## Authentication

The API uses [Sanctum personal access tokens](https://laravel.com/docs/sanctum)
sent as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <XCLOUD_API_TOKEN>
```

Generate one in the xCloud dashboard → **Profile → API Tokens → Generate New
Token**, choosing scopes (`read:sites`, `write:sites`, `read:servers`,
`write:servers`, or `*`). It's shown once — copy it immediately.

Scopes are coarse; each request also passes a per-resource policy check. A
**403** with a valid token means a missing team permission (e.g.
`site:manage-ssl` for SSL renewal), not a bad token. A **401** means the token
is missing, expired, or revoked.

## Response envelope

Every response uses the same wrapper:

```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Success", "data": {} }
```

On error, `success` is `false` and `message` carries the reason; the HTTP
status is authoritative.

## Pagination

List endpoints return **either** shape — inspect before assuming:

- `data.items` + `data.pagination` (most live endpoints)
- `data.data` + `data.meta` (some examples)

Max **100** per page.

## Rate limits & async writes

Authenticated callers get **60 req/min** (10 unauthenticated). A **429** returns
`Retry-After` — honor it. Writes often return success immediately while work
continues; poll the matching read endpoint (status / events / tasks) to confirm
completion.

get.description:
Returns all servers on the team. Plain language: 'show me my servers', 'list all servers'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Fetch a single server's details by UUID. Plain language: 'show me this server', 'get server details'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists the sites hosted on a given server. Plain language: 'what sites are on this server'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Returns current monitoring metrics (CPU, memory, disk) for the server. Plain language: 'how is this server doing', 'server stats'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Returns historical monitoring metrics for the server over time. Plain language: 'server usage over time', 'monitoring history'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists the running services on a server (nginx, mysql, etc.). Plain language: 'what services are running'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Restarts a named service on the server (async). Plain language: 'restart nginx', 'restart mysql'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Returns recent async tasks for a server; used to confirm progress after any async write. Plain language: 'what's happening on this server', 'check task progress'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists snapshots taken of the server. Plain language: 'show server snapshots'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists Supervisor-managed processes on the server. Plain language: 'show supervisor workers'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Reboots the server (async — poll tasks afterward). Plain language: 'reboot the server', 'restart this server'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

Provisions a new WordPress site on the server. Live mode needs domain + ssl; omit domain for demo. blueprint_uuid and snapshot_uuid are mutually exclusive; auto-generated credentials returned only once. Plain language: 'spin up a WordPress site on this server'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

domain.description: required for live mode, omit for demo

get.description:
Lists PHP versions installed on the server. Plain language: 'what PHP versions are installed'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Installs a PHP version on the server (async — confirm via tasks). Plain language: 'install PHP 8.3'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

delete.description:
Uninstalls a PHP version from the server. Plain language: 'remove PHP 8.1'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Lists PHP versions available to install on the server. Plain language: 'which PHP versions can I install'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Returns patch availability/info for installed PHP versions. Plain language: 'are there PHP patches available'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Sets a PHP version as the server default. Plain language: 'make PHP 8.3 the default'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

Enables or disables OPcache for a PHP version. Plain language: 'turn on opcache for PHP 8.3'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

Applies the latest patch to a PHP version (async — confirm via tasks). Plain language: 'patch PHP 8.3'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Lists scheduled cron jobs at the server level. Plain language: 'show server cron jobs'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Creates a server-level cron job. Plain language: 'add a cron job to this server'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

put.description:
Updates an existing server-level cron job. Plain language: 'change this server cron job'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

delete.description:
Deletes a server-level cron job. Plain language: 'remove this server cron job'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

post.description:
Triggers an immediate run of a server cron job. Plain language: 'run this cron job now'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Returns the last output of a server cron job. Plain language: 'show the output of this cron job'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists databases on the server. Plain language: 'show databases on this server'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Creates a database on the server (keyed by name in body, not path UUID). Plain language: 'create a database'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

delete.description:
Deletes a database on the server (keyed by name in body). Plain language: 'delete this database'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Searches databases on the server by query. Plain language: 'find a database named X'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists database users on the server. Plain language: 'show database users'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Creates a database user with access to specified databases. Plain language: 'create a database user'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

databases.description: database names the user may access (required)

put.description:
Updates a database user's database access (keyed by username in body). Plain language: 'change this database user's access'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

delete.description:
Deletes a database user (keyed by username in body). Plain language: 'remove this database user'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Searches database users on the server by query. Plain language: 'find a database user'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists firewall rules on the server. Plain language: 'show firewall rules'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Creates a firewall rule on the server. Plain language: 'open port 5432', 'allow traffic from an IP'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

ip_address.description: optional source IP to scope the rule

delete.description:
Deletes a firewall rule by UUID. Plain language: 'remove this firewall rule'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

post.description:
Enables a firewall rule. Plain language: 'turn on this firewall rule'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

Disables a firewall rule. Plain language: 'turn off this firewall rule'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Lists IPs currently banned by fail2ban. Plain language: 'show banned IPs'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Bans one or more IPs via fail2ban. Plain language: 'ban this IP'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

delete.description:
Unbans a single IP from fail2ban. Plain language: 'unban this IP'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Returns the SSH IP-restriction status for the server. Plain language: 'is SSH restricted'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Whitelists the IP making the API call in the server firewall. Plain language: 'whitelist my IP'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

Whitelists xCloud infrastructure IPs in the server firewall. Plain language: 'whitelist xCloud IPs'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Lists OS-level privileged (sudo) accounts on the server. Plain language: 'show sudo users'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

post.description:
Creates or updates an OS-level sudo user. Supply username plus either SSH keys or a password. Private keys never returned. Plain language: 'add a sudo user'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

delete.description:
Deletes an OS-level sudo user by UUID. Plain language: 'remove this sudo user'.

**Scope:** `write:servers`

get.description:
Lists all sites; supports search to resolve a site UUID by domain. Plain language: 'show my sites', 'find the site for example.com'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term; resolves a site UUID by domain.

get.description:
Fetch a single site's details by UUID. Plain language: 'show me this site'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's current status; go-to triage read with events. Plain language: 'is my site up', 'site status'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns recent site events; used to confirm async writes. Plain language: 'what happened to my site recently'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns deployment logs for the site. Plain language: 'show deployment logs'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns current monitoring metrics for the site. Plain language: 'site performance metrics'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns historical monitoring metrics for the site. Plain language: 'site metrics over time'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns web access logs for the site. Plain language: 'show access logs', 'who's hitting my site'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's connected git repository info. Plain language: 'what repo is this site deploying from'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists snapshots of the site. Plain language: 'show site snapshots'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists staging environments for the site. Plain language: 'show staging sites'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's custom nginx configuration. Plain language: 'show custom nginx config'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's deployment/site scripts. Plain language: 'show site scripts'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's IP access control configuration. Plain language: 'show IP access rules'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Runs repair operations on a broken site; all flags optional booleans, pick the repairs needed. Plain language: 'fix my broken site', 'rescue this site'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

Triggers a backup of the site (async — poll backup-status). Plain language: 'back up my site'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Lists backups for the site. Plain language: 'show my backups'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the number of backups for the site. Plain language: 'how many backups do I have'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's backup configuration. Plain language: 'show backup settings'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns status of the latest/in-progress backup; poll after triggering. Plain language: 'is my backup done'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's primary domain info. Read-only in the public API. Plain language: 'what's my domain'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns domain change/propagation status; poll after a domain change. Plain language: 'has my domain propagated'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists all domains attached to the site. Plain language: 'show all my domains'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists URL redirections configured for the site. Read-only in the public API. Plain language: 'show redirects'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists web rules configured for the site. Read-only in the public API. Plain language: 'show web rules'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the site's cache configuration. Plain language: 'show cache settings'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Clears only the full-page cache (async — confirm via events). Plain language: 'clear page cache'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

Clears every cache layer: full-page + object + CDN (async). Plain language: 'clear all caches', 'flush everything'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Returns SSH/SFTP config including site_user; useful for triaging a 502 from a missing OS user. Private keys never returned. Plain language: 'show SSH config'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

put.description:
Updates SSH/SFTP authentication mode. public_key mode requires ssh_public_keys; password mode requires password. Plain language: 'switch to key-based SSH', 'set an SFTP password'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Lists SSH keys configured for the site. Plain language: 'show SSH keys'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists site-level cron jobs (run as the site user). Plain language: 'show site cron jobs'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Creates a site-level cron job; runs as the site user (no user field, unlike server cron). Plain language: 'add a cron job to my site'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

put.description:
Updates an existing site-level cron job. Plain language: 'change this site cron job'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

delete.description:
Deletes a site-level cron job. Plain language: 'remove this site cron job'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

post.description:
Triggers an immediate run of a site cron job. Plain language: 'run this site cron job now'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Returns the last output of a site cron job. Plain language: 'show output of this site cron job'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns WordPress health status for the site. Plain language: 'is WordPress healthy', 'WP status'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns a summary of pending WordPress core/plugin/theme updates. Plain language: 'what updates are pending'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Enables or disables WP_DEBUG on the site. Plain language: 'turn on WP debug'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

Generates a single-use, short-lived admin magic-login URL; never log it. Plain language: 'log me into WP admin', 'give me a login link'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Lists WordPress plugins on the site, optionally filtered by status. Plain language: 'show my plugins', 'list active plugins'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists WordPress themes on the site. Plain language: 'show my themes'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Updates WordPress items (async — confirm via events). slugs targets specific items; omit for all of that type. Plain language: 'update WooCommerce', 'update all plugins'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

slugs.description: specific items; omit for all of that type

post.description:
Activates WordPress items (async — confirm via events). Plain language: 'activate WooCommerce'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

Refreshes the cached plugin/theme inventory before reading it. Plain language: 'refresh my plugin list'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Lists vulnerability findings for the site (sources like Patchstack/Wordfence). Plain language: 'show vulnerabilities', 'is my site vulnerable'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns vulnerability counts grouped by severity (critical/high/medium/low). Plain language: 'how many vulnerabilities'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Triggers a vulnerability rescan (async — poll count or events). Plain language: 'scan my site for vulnerabilities'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

Marks a vulnerability finding as ignored, optionally with a reason. Plain language: 'ignore this vulnerability', 'mark as false positive'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

delete.description:
Removes the ignored status from a vulnerability finding. Plain language: 'un-ignore this vulnerability'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Returns a team-wide vulnerability rollup; the top-level endpoint requires a site query param. Plain language: 'show all vulnerabilities for this site across the team'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns the latest PageSpeed Insights snapshot (performance, lcp, cls, inp). Plain language: 'how fast is my site', 'PageSpeed score'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns historical PageSpeed snapshots for the site. Plain language: 'PageSpeed over time'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Triggers a PageSpeed Insights scan (async — poll the latest snapshot). Applies to any site. Plain language: 'run a PageSpeed scan'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Returns current SSL state for a site. Private key material never returned. Plain language: 'is HTTPS set up', 'show SSL info'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Lists SSL certificates for a site. Plain language: 'show my certificates'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

post.description:
Installs an SSL certificate via xcloud (Let's Encrypt), custom (PEM), or cloudflare (async — poll status). force required to switch to a different provider; ssl_search_replace applies to WordPress sites only. Plain language: 'set up HTTPS', 'install an SSL cert'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

force.description: required only to switch to a different provider

ssl_search_replace.description: WordPress only; runs DB search-replace for HTTPS

post.description:
Renews the site certificate; no-op unless within 7 days of expiry unless force is true. Returns 403 without site:manage-ssl. Plain language: 'renew my SSL cert'.

**Scope:** `write:sites + site:manage-ssl`

get.description:
Fetches a certificate's details by its UUID. Plain language: 'show this certificate'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

delete.description:
Deletes a certificate by UUID. Plain language: 'remove this SSL cert'.

**Scope:** `write:sites`

get.description:
Returns issuance/installation status for a certificate; poll after install or renew. Plain language: 'is my cert issued yet'.

**Scope:** `read:sites`

Returns API health; the only unauthenticated endpoint. Plain language: 'is the API up'.

**Scope:** `none`

Returns the authenticated user and team; verifies the token. Plain language: 'who am I', 'whoami'.

**Scope:** `token`

Lists the user's API tokens; returns 403 unless the token carries the * scope. Plain language: 'show my API tokens'.

**Scope:** `token (*)`

delete.description:
Revokes an API token by its numeric id (not a UUID). Plain language: 'revoke this token', 'delete an API key'.

**Scope:** `token (*)`

get.description:
Lists Cloudflare integrations configured on the team. Plain language: 'show Cloudflare integrations'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

Lists WordPress blueprints; resolve a blueprint_uuid before creating a WordPress site. Requires read:servers (not read:sites). Plain language: 'show my blueprints'.

**Scope:** `read:servers`

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum personal access token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Forbidden.description: Token lacks the required scope or team permission.

NotFound.description: Resource not found for the given identifier.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded; honor the Retry-After header.
